title: Codex 上下文压缩究竟改变了什么

source.harness_execution: real installed App Server launched through PMA exact Capture Proxy
source.upstream: deterministic local OpenAI Responses SSE fixture
source.protocol: OpenAI Responses using local summary compaction

audiences: 第一次想理解 Codex 长会话的用户
排查上下文变化和摘要丢失的 Harness 使用者
开发自有 Agent 并核对 compaction 请求形态的工程师
teaching_contract.question: 手动触发 compact 后，Codex 发出了什么请求，下一次 History 又怎样保留用户事实、接续摘要和项目规则？
teaching_contract.takeaway: 当前 PMA 自定义 provider 下，Codex 发送一条 request_kind=compaction 的普通 Responses 请求生成可读摘要；后续请求保留选中的用户消息，用摘要接替较早 Assistant 历史，并重新注入当前规则。PMA 保留压缩前后的精确 Capture，可直接比较。
explicit_limits: The real component under test is Codex App Server and its request assembly; all model replies come from a deterministic local fake upstream.
This trace demonstrates manual compaction only, not automatic threshold behavior.
A shorter History, token drop, or cache statistic alone is not sufficient evidence of compaction.
The PMA exact proxy configures a named custom provider, so Codex 0.144.6 selects local summary compaction over the OpenAI/Azure-only remote compaction path.
This Source does not demonstrate /v1/responses/compact or opaque compaction items; those remain a separate supported protocol path.
PMA observes compaction but does not trigger it. The PMA maintenance command pma compact is unrelated.

experiment.post_compaction_question: 压缩已经完成。请用一句话复述项目代号、入口文件和观察指南。

facts: The real App Server produced five OpenAI Responses requests across four ordinary PMA Turns.
Request 4 is labeled Harness context compaction inside Turn 3 and carries request_kind=compaction in x-codex-turn-metadata.
Request 4 uses /v1/responses, contains nine input items, and appends Codex's checkpoint prompt after three user/assistant pairs.
Request 4 Harness contains a harness_compact item at messages[8].
Request 5 History retains the three real user messages, replaces earlier assistant messages with a continuation summary, and re-injects current permissions, environment, and AGENTS.md.
Request 5 Message contains only the current post-compaction question.
The deterministic Request 5 response still uses all three public facts.
Codex also supports a separate remote /responses/compact path for built-in OpenAI or recognized Azure providers; it is not present in this Source.

corrections: The first batch captured the 700ms scene fade and appeared washed out; it was rejected and regenerated after adding the review-only frozen state.
The frozen review state keeps click pulses visible at their real control centers without changing normal playback animation.

A full-size re-review found that the overview markers were shifted one event upward: marker 1 framed Turn 2 and marker 2 framed the ordinary Request 3. Both focus regions were moved to the actual Turn 3 and its nested compaction Request 4, then the four affected desktop and compact frames plus both contact sheets were regenerated.
The 1 -> 2 -> 3 History sequence was inspected in both viewports: marker 1 dims for marker 2, exits before marker 3, and marker 2 remains only as a dim comparison.
annotation_policy: Numbered annotations appear in teaching order, never all at scene entry.
A previous marker remains only for an explicit comparison and dims before the next marker becomes primary.
The three-part post-compaction History scene removes marker 1 before marker 3 appears, preventing a fully annotated cluttered end state.
Clicks, focus outlines, and numbered badges establish every relationship; no routed arrows are used in v0.1.
